changeSet.comment: Practices that hold the exact text of a bundled script move to the public script API.
changeSet.sql:
-- Each row is the exact text of a released bundled script and the same script on the public API. Text that no row names stays as its author wrote it. CREATE TEMP TABLE _cutover_program( source_sha256 varchar(64) PRIMARY KEY,source text NOT NULL,target_sha256 varchar(64) NOT NULL,target text NOT NULL, CHECK(source_sha256=encode(sha256(convert_to(source,'UTF8')),'hex')), CHECK(target_sha256=encode(sha256(convert_to(target,'UTF8')),'hex'))) ON COMMIT DROP; CREATE FUNCTION pg_temp.public_api_script(definition jsonb) RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$ SELECT coalesce( (SELECT jsonb_set(definition,'{script}',to_jsonb(p.target)) FROM _cutover_program p WHERE definition->>'script' IS NOT NULL AND p.source_sha256=encode(sha256(convert_to(definition->>'script','UTF8')),'hex')), definition) $$;
-- A new version, so that earlier results keep the definition that they measured. Nothing starts a review. WITH rewritten AS( SELECT p.id,p.workspace_id,pg_temp.public_api_script(v.definition) AS definition,v.definition AS previous FROM practice p JOIN practice_version v ON v.id=p.current_version_id), inserted AS( INSERT INTO practice_version(workspace_id,practice_id,number,definition,created_at) SELECT r.workspace_id,r.id,(SELECT max(v.number)+1 FROM practice_version v WHERE v.practice_id=r.id),r.definition,transaction_timestamp() FROM rewritten r WHERE r.definition IS DISTINCT FROM r.previous RETURNING id,practice_id) UPDATE practice p SET current_version_id=i.id,updated_at=transaction_timestamp() FROM inserted i WHERE p.id=i.practice_id;
-- The base and the catalog move with the script, so that this change is not offered as a catalog update. UPDATE practice SET catalog_base=jsonb_set(catalog_base,'{definition}',pg_temp.public_api_script(catalog_base->'definition')) WHERE catalog_base->'definition'->>'script' IS NOT NULL; UPDATE catalog_entry SET definition=jsonb_set(definition,'{definition}',pg_temp.public_api_script(definition->'definition')) WHERE entry_type='PRACTICE' AND definition->'definition'->>'script' IS NOT NULL; UPDATE catalog_entry SET base=jsonb_set(base,'{definition}',pg_temp.public_api_script(base->'definition')) WHERE entry_type='PRACTICE' AND base->'definition'->>'script' IS NOT NULL;
